title: Adult Follow-up of Preventive Study With Brief Smoking Intervention for Adolescents
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to see whether a brief intervention given in adolescence has an effect on smoking in adulthood. The investigators also wanted to clarify the significance of some known psychosocial risk factors of smoking in adulthood.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Born on 1979.
* Living in Vaasa, Pietarsaari, Kokkola or Seinäjoki at school age.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other year of birth.
